sloka: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः ।सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर ।। ५.६८.७ ।।।।
transliteration: ayaṁ ca vīra sandehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ ।sumahāṁstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara ।। 5.68.7 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O brave vanaras I have great doubts about your assistants the vanaras and bears, crossing the ocean.
